property_summary: For any admissible (actor, amount>0): after a successful deposit and one successful withdrawAll, the caller's credit is fully consumed, so a second withdrawAll is a harmless no-op that must succeed without reverting; the mutant leaves credit outstanding, so the second withdrawal tries to pay out again from an empty contract and reverts.
change_summary: Remove the statement that zeroes out the caller's credit after withdrawal, so repeated calls to withdrawAll can withdraw the same credit again.
